講者.Name: Deborah Lupton
講者.服務單位: 澳洲雪梨新南威爾斯大學藝術、設計與建築學院
講者.Organization: University of New South Wales Sydney
講者.Title: SHARP Professor
講者.簡介:
Deborah Lupton 為澳洲新南威爾斯大學藝術、設計與建築學院SHARP講座教授，並同時任職於該校的社會政策研究中心與健康社會研究中心。他帶領Vitalities Lab研究團隊以及澳洲研究委員會「自動化決策與社會卓越中心」在新南威爾斯大學的團隊進行研究。
他的研究具有跨學科特性，涵蓋社會學、媒體與文化研究，並經常運用以藝術為基礎與其他具創意性的方法來進行學術研究與社群參與。他長期關注數位科技、演算法、健康、風險與社會文化之間的關係，為醫療社會學領域重要的學者，近年也跨足未來社會學、生成式AI的批判研究等。
Lupton 榮獲多項重要學術殊榮，包括2017 年當選澳洲社會科學院（ASSA）院士、2024 年當選澳洲健康與醫學科學院（AAHMS）院士，以及2022年當選新南威爾斯皇家學會（RSNSW）院士，並曾獲得兩座榮譽博士學位。

Lupton 教授的研究核心在於批判性地檢視數位技術、資料化（datafication）與身體、健康、風險及自我的交織關係。她是數位社會研究的先驅，著有《數位社會學》（Digital Sociology）、《量化自我》（The Quantified Self）、《數位健康》（Digital Health）與《資料自我》（Data Selves）等多部里程碑專著。

在理論與方法論創新上，她融合女性主義新唯物主義（Feminist New Materialism）與「超越人類視角」（More-than-human perspective），提出「人-資料裝配體」（human-data assemblages）與「活資料」（lively data）等核心概念。她主張個人資料並非去物質化的冰冷代碼，而是與人類肉體、感官及日常生活常軌動態糾纏、共同生成的活性實體。此外，她的研究領域亦廣泛涵蓋身體政治（如《脂肪》、《醫療文化》）、自動化決策（ADM）治理，以及 COVID-19 危機的社會影響研究。
講者.Biography: Deborah Lupton is SHARP Professor in the Faculty of Arts, Design & Architecture, University of New South Wales (UNSW) Sydney, Australia. Her research is interdisciplinary, spanning sociology, media and cultural studies, and often involves arts-based and other creative methods for research and community engagement. She is located in the Centre for Social Research in Health and the Social Policy Research Centre, leading both the Vitalities Lab and the UNSW Node of the Australian Research Council Centre of Excellence for Automated Decision-Making and Society. Professor Lupton is an elected Fellow of the Academy of the Social Sciences in Australia, the Australian Academy of Health and Medical Sciences and the Royal Society of NSW, and has been awarded two honorary doctorates. She is the author/editor of more than 30 academic books.

講者.簡介:
邱文聰現為中央研究院法律學研究所研究員，並為該所資訊法中心首位主任。他的研究領域包括資訊法、憲法隱私權、食品管制、科學技術與社會研究（STS）與法律、生醫及公共衛生倫理，以及國家安全法。

他於 2004 年取得維吉尼亞大學法學博士（S.J.D.）學位，另分別取得賓夕法尼亞大學及國立臺灣大學的法學碩士（LL.M.）學位，並畢業於國立臺灣大學法律學系，取得法學士（LL.B.）學位。

目前擔任中央研究院智財技轉處處長，並為臺灣 AI 卓越中心（AICoE）AI治理組召集人。
講者.Biography:
Wen-Tsong Chiou is research fellow at the Institutum Iurisprudentiae
of the Academia Sinica in Taiwan, and the founding director of the institute’s Information Law Center. His research focuses on information law, constitutional privacy, food regulation, STS & law, biomedical and public health ethics, and national security law. He holds a S.J.D. from University of Virginia (2004), two L.L.M.s
respectively from the University of Pennsylvania and National Taiwan University, and an LL.B from National Taiwan University. He currently serves as the director of the Office of Intellectual Property and Technology Transfer, Academia Sinica and co-chairs the AI governance
division of Taiwan AICoE.

講者.Biography:
Shun-Ling Chen is an associate research professor at Institutum Iurisprudentiae Academia Sinica (IIAS). She also co-directs the Information Law Center at IIAS.
Shun-Ling holds an S.J.D. from Harvard Law School. She has worked closely with online collaboration and civic tech communities. Trained in both Law and Science and technology studies, her research interest include copyright, privacy, peer production, citizen science, community governance, platform governance, internet governance and data governance.

講者.Name: Andrea Wei-Ching Huang
講者.服務單位: 中央研究院社會學研究所
講者.Title: AI Sociology Project Research Manager
講者.簡介:
黃韋菁是台灣中央研究院社會學研究所AI社會學專案研究經理。她致力於探索AI不僅是一項技術成就，更是一面反映我們社會渴望與焦慮的鏡子。她與吳齊殷教授合作進行AI社會學研究，探討AI如何參與我們集體生活中，塑造信任、偏見/偏誤以及脆弱的社群連結。
 
同時，她對本體論的興趣也反映了一個更深層的問題：我們如何命名和建構世界，以便機器能夠理解它？在這個過程中，我們又如何重塑我們對自身的認知？她曾在國際會議上發表演講，並發表了多篇論文。她的ORCID學術個人資料(https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9781-3352)中詳細介紹了她的研究歷程。
講者.Biography:
Andrea Wei-Ching Huang is an AI Sociology Project Research Manager at Institute of Sociology, Academia Sinica, Taiwan. She devoted to exploring the ways in which AI is not merely a technical achievement but a mirror of our social longings and anxieties. Her works in AI Sociology with Professor Wu Chyi-In ask how AI become participants in our collective dramas, shaping trust, bias, and the fragile bonds of community.
 
Alongside this, her interest in Ontology reflects a deeper question: how do we name and structure the world so that machines may understand it, and in doing so, how do we reshape our own understanding of ourselves? She has spoken at international conferences and published papers. The whole story’s laid out in her ORCID profile (https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9781-3352).

講者.Name: Chyi-In Wu
講者.服務單位: 中央研究院社會學研究所
講者.Title: Research Fellow
講者.簡介: 吳齊殷，現任中央研究院社會學研究所研究員，曾任該所副所長，並主持多項國內大型社會調查計畫（「台灣社會變遷基本調查」、「台灣農村社會與人口調查」、「台灣數位世代青少年成長歷程研究」）。於1993年獲得美國愛荷華州立大學社會學博士學位，是大型社會調查領域的專家。研究主要聚焦在生命歷程視野下青少年的身心發展結果，特別關注社會網絡如何影響青少年的福祉。其研究亦關注家庭、階級、學校及社區等情境因素，探討這些結構性因素如何與青少年的社會活動相互交織，進而對青少年福祉產生影響。其研究成果發表於多本國際著名學術期刊，Criminology、Social Psychology Quarterly、Journal of Research on Adolescence、Journal of Child and Family Studies、Evolution and Human Behavior等；其關於社會網絡的最新研究，則發表於Social Networks。
講者.Biography: Chyi-In Wu is a Research Fellow of the Institute of Sociology at Academia Sinica in Taiwan and is the Principal Investigator of several major social survey projects (i.e., Taiwan Social Change Survey ; Taiwan Rural Social and Population Survey; Taiwan I-Generation Panel Study). He received his PhD in Sociology from Iowa State University in 1993. He is an expert in large scale social survey. His research majorly focuses on the outcomes of adolescent physical and psychological development in a life course perspective. Particularly, he is interested in how social networks influence adolescent well-being. In addition, his research also pays attention to the contextual factors like family, class, school, community and so on to investigate how these structural factors interweaving with adolescent’s social activities and eventually generating impact upon adolescent well-being. His work has appeared in numerous journals including Criminology, Social Psychology Quarterly, Journal of Research on Adolescence, Journal of Child and Family Studies, Evolution and Human Behavior, International Sociology, Current Sociology, and his most recent research work on social network appears in the Social Networks.

講者.Name: Wayne Hsuan-Wei Lee
講者.服務單位: 美國理海大學健康學院
講者.Title: Assistant Professor
講者.簡介:
李宣緯（Hsuan-Wei “Wayne” Lee），美國理海大學（Lehigh University）健康學院生物統計與健康資料科學系助理教授，並合聘於數學系。2019 年至 2024 年任中央研究院社會學研究所助研究員，期間兼任國立臺灣大學政治學系與社會學系助理教授，並合聘於臺大物理學系。美國北卡羅來納大學教堂山分校數學博士。
他的研究關注「關於人的資料」如何被生產，以及這些資料流通之後帶來什麼後果。他結合網絡科學、統計模型與機器學習，分析平台與社會結構如何形塑制度所依賴的證據。相關研究包括線上網絡中的政治機器人與意見極化、臉書大數據與社會關係的形成，以及社會資本與信任的分布。他也曾擔任科技部計畫共同主持人，研究轉介網絡如何在勞動市場中區隔少數群體工作者，並參與建置網路輿情動態資料庫。
另一條研究主軸是權力不對等下的測量問題:如何在保護匿名的前提下估計隱藏與弱勢族群的規模、如何測量人口販運被害者的能動性，以及臺灣的轉型正義與健康、幸福感和社會團結之間的關係。他目前的研究探討人工智慧生成的「合成受訪者」能否取代真實民眾參與社會調查，以及電子病歷所記錄的臨床決策中如何出現差別對待。
已發表四十餘篇期刊論文，刊登於 Humanities and Social Sciences Communications、Computers in Human Behavior、Social Science Computer Review、Social Networks、Social Science & Medicine 等期刊。現為理海大學駐聯合國代表。
講者.Biography:
Hsuan-Wei "Wayne" Lee is an Assistant Professor of Biostatistics and Health Data Science in
the College of Health at Lehigh University, with a faculty appointment in the Department of
Mathematics. From 2019 to 2024 he was an Assistant Research Fellow at the Institute of
Sociology, Academia Sinica. During this period he also held adjunct appointments in political
science and sociology and a joint appointment in physics at National Taiwan University. He
received his Ph.D. in Mathematics from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
His research asks how data about people is produced, and what it does once it circulates. Using
network science, statistical modeling, and machine learning, he studies how platforms and social
structure shape the evidence that institutions rely on. He has written on political bots and opinion
polarization in online networks, on large-scale Facebook data and the formation of social ties,
and on the distribution of social capital and trust. As a co-investigator on projects funded by
Taiwan's Ministry of Science and Technology, he studied how referral networks segregate
minority workers in labor markets and helped build dynamic databases of online public opinion.
A second line of his work concerns measurement under unequal power: estimating the size of
hidden and vulnerable populations while preserving anonymity, measuring agency among
trafficking victims, and examining how transitional justice in Taiwan relates to health, happiness,
and social solidarity. His current projects ask whether AI-generated synthetic respondents can
stand in for real people in social surveys, and how disparities enter clinical decisions recorded in
electronic health records.
He has published more than 40 peer-reviewed articles in journals including Humanities and
Social Sciences Communications, Computers in Human Behavior, Social Science Computer
Review, Social Networks, and Social Science & Medicine. He also serves as Lehigh University's
representative to the United Nations through its ECOSOC consultative status.

講者.Name: Chun-Chi Hung
講者.服務單位: 國立清華大學科技法律研究所
講者.Organization: Institute of Law for Science and Technology, National Tsing Hua University
講者.Title: Associate Professor
講者.簡介:
洪淳琦副教授畢業於台大法律系、台大法律研究所公法組，其後獲教育部公費，於美國哈佛法學院取得法學碩士；再赴英國研究智慧財產權與科技法。在英國期間，她先在倫敦政經學院「法律、人類學與社會」碩士班中，研究新科技與社會、法律的互動；再進入倫敦大學瑪麗皇后學院商法研究中心的博士班，研究國際智慧財產權法及原住民族傳統智慧創作。她的博士論文獲得罕見的最高級成績—口試委員一致同意「無條件、無須修改」直接通過。

在加入清大科法所之前，她曾在國際法律事務所和上市公司擔任律師及主管，也曾獨立執業，擔任科技公司、文化團體、及知名藝術家之法律顧問。她目前在清大科法所教授憲法、國際智慧財產權法、營業秘密法、專利法。在進行中的研究主題包含：國家安全視野下的智慧財產權議題、原住民族資料主權、資料治理與性別議題。她曾獲國立清華大學科技管理學院新進人員研究獎、科技管理學院傑出教學獎、國立清華大學傑出教學獎。
講者.Biography:
Chun-Chi Hung is an Associate Professor at the Institute of Law for Science and Technology at National Tsing Hua University, Taiwan. She earned her bachelor’s degree in law and a master’s degree specializing in public law from National Taiwan University. With a scholarship from Taiwan’s Ministry of Education, she subsequently obtained an LL.M. from Harvard Law School before moving to the United Kingdom to pursue further studies in intellectual property and technology law.

In the United Kingdom, she first completed an MSc in Law, Anthropology and Society at the London School of Economics and Political Science, examining the interactions between emerging technologies, society, and law. She then pursued a PhD at the Centre for Commercial Law Studies at Queen Mary University of London, focusing on international intellectual property law and Indigenous traditional cultural expressions. Her dissertation achieved the exceptional outcome of a unanimous, unconditional pass, with no revisions required.

Before joining National Tsing Hua University, she worked as an attorney-at-law and held managerial positions at an international law firm and a publicly listed company. She also practised independently, serving as legal counsel to technology companies, cultural organizations, and prominent artists. She currently teaches constitutional law, international intellectual property law, trade secrets law, and patent law. Her ongoing research explores intellectual property issues in the context of national security, Indigenous data sovereignty, and the intersections of data governance and gender.

She has received the New Faculty Research Award and the Outstanding Teaching Award from National Tsing Hua University’s College of Technology Management, as well as the university’s Outstanding Teaching Award.

講者.Name: Tyng-Ruey Chuang

講者.Biography: Tyng-Ruey Chuang is an Associate Research Fellow at Academia Sinica, Taiwan, and leads the depositar lab at the Institute of Information Science. His team runs the depositar (data.depositar.io), a public repository for the deposit, discovery, and reuse of research datasets aligned with the FAIR Data Principles. He advises the Long-Term Socio-Ecological Research (LTSER) program at the National Science and Technology Council (NSTC) of Taiwan on data management issues. He was an elected member of the Executive Committee of CODATA at the International Science Council (2018–2025). He led Creative Commons Taiwan, hosted by Academia Sinica since its inception, for 15 years before its transition to a community project in 2018. He was the recipient of a Fulbright Senior Research Grant and a Fellow (2011–2012) at the Berkman Center for Internet and Society, Harvard University .

講者.Title: Associate Professor
講者.簡介: 國立陽明交通大學科技與社會所副教授，研究以數位創新為主題，關心其造成之都市與氣候治理、公眾參與和日常生活的轉變，援引科技與社會研究、批判數據與演算法研究、地理學、社會學及流動性研究進行跨領域探索。
講者.Biography: Sung-Yueh Perng is an Associate Professor at the Institute of Science, Technology and Society, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, whose research focuses on digital innovation and its transformative impacts on urban and climate governance, public participation, and everyday life. Drawing on science and technology studies (STS), critical data and algorithm studies, geography, sociology, and mobility studies, his work takes an interdisciplinary approach to understanding these transformations.

講者.Name: Mei-Chun Lee
講者.服務單位: 中央研究院民族學研究所
講者.Title: Associate Research Fellow
講者.簡介: 李梅君現職為中央研究院民族學研究所副研究員，研究專長包含數位人類學、批判資料學、科技與社會研究、資料政治、黑客行動主義、後人類戰爭、以及假訊息。
講者.Biography: Mei-Chun Lee is an Associate Research Fellow at the Institute of Ethnology.

講者.Name: Tzu-I Lee
講者.服務單位: 國立臺灣科技大學專利研究所
講者.Organization: Graduate Institute of Patent, National Taiwan University of Science and Technology
講者.Title: Assistant Professor
講者.簡介: 國立臺灣科技大學專利研究所助理教授，具跨領域學術背景，擁有美國加州大學柏克萊分校法學碩士（LL.M.）、伊利諾大學芝加哥分校法學博士（J.D.）、國立臺灣大學地理學博士，以及英國華威大學文學碩士學位。研究領域涵蓋智慧財產權法、人工智慧法律與政策、及法律地理學。近期研究聚焦於聲音複製、臺灣音樂產業的法律地理、半導體產業營業秘密治理，以及人工智慧著作權議題。
講者.Biography: Tzu-I Lee is an Assistant Professor at the Graduate Institute of Patent, National Taiwan University of Science and Technology. She has an interdisciplinary academic background, holding an LL.M. from Berkeley Law, a J.D. from UIC School of Law, a Ph.D. in Geography from National Taiwan University, and an M.A. from the University of Warwick. Her research interests include intellectual property law, AI law and policy, and legal geography. Her recent research focuses on voice cloning, the legal geography of Taiwan's music industry, trade secret governance in the semiconductor industry, and AI copyright issues.

講者.Name: Chang-Chiang Hsieh
講者.服務單位: 逢甲大學財經法律研究所
講者.Organization: Graduate Institute of Financial and Economic Law, Feng Chia University
講者.Title: Assistant Professor
講者.簡介: 謝長江為國立臺灣大學法律學系博士，現任逢甲大學財經法律研究所助理教授。謝先生擁有經濟學、公法學及歐盟經濟法之碩士學位，並曾於中央研究院作為人文社會科學博士候選人培育計畫人員，以及於臺灣大學擔任博士後研究人員。其博士論文探討當代競爭政策如何因應資料經濟與永續發展之挑戰，且持續研究競爭法、法律經濟學、產業管制以及人工智慧與資料治理相關議題。
講者.Biography: Chang-Chiang Hsieh holds a Ph.D. in Law from National Taiwan University and currently serves as an Assistant Professor at the Graduate Institute of Financial and Economic Law at Feng Chia University. He also holds master’s degrees in Economics, Public Law, and European Economic Law. His prior academic appointments include serving as a Doctoral Fellow at Institutum Iurisprudentiae Academia Sinica and as a Postdoctoral Fellow at National Taiwan University. His doctoral dissertation examined how contemporary competition policy addresses the dual challenges of the data economy and sustainable development. His ongoing research focuses on competition law, law and economics, industrial regulation, and the regulatory intersections of data governance and artificial intelligence.

講者.Name: Chia-Yang Lin
講者.服務單位: 輔仁大學法律學系
講者.Organization: Department of Law, Fu Jen Catholic University
講者.Title: Assistant Professor
講者.簡介: 家暘現任職於天主教輔仁大學法律學系，專業領域為憲法、行政法與通訊傳播法，目前開設行政法、行政救濟法與公平交易法專題研究等課程。留學撰寫關於電信法市場管制之博士論文時，受指導教授指點，應對於歐盟與德國競爭法多加研修，從此與競爭法結下不解之緣。回國後陸續寫出關於網路上不公平競爭行為、德國競爭法數位化改革以及評析臺灣通訊傳播事業結合案等論文。近年亦受國家通訊傳播委員會委託，執行有關OTT-TV以及網路平臺治理研究計畫。
講者.Biography: Chia-Yang currently serves at the School of Law, FJCU. His fields of specialization include Constitutional Law, Administrative Law, and Communication Law. He currently teaches courses such as Administrative Law, The Administrative Relief Act, and Seminar on Fair Trade Law. While studying abroad to write his doctoral dissertation on telecom market regulation, his supervisor advised him to undertake in-depth research on EU and German competition law, which sparked an enduring connection with the subject. After returning home, he authored a series of papers covering unfair competition on the internet, the digital reform of German competition law, and reviews of communication and broadcasting merger cases in Taiwan. In recent years, he has also been commissioned by the National Communications Commission to conduct research projects on OTT-TV and online platform governance.

講者.Name: Yi-Ting Chen
講者.服務單位: 中央研究院法律學研究所
講者.Title: Postdoctoral Scholar
講者.簡介:
目前擔任中央研究院法律學研究所資訊法中心博士後研究學者，主要負責為AI政策建議提供比較法學的見解與分析。她的學術軌跡扎根於法律衝突法與法律和科技之間結合的交會點，其博士論文題為International Law and Artificial General Intelligence，在此之前，她完成了以 AI 法律規範與跨國企業社會責任為主題的碩士論文。
延續這些研究主題，她發表的學術內容探討了多項前沿法律議題，例如AGI與Strong AI對國際法作為法律體系之意涵、AI 的法律定位與慎防義務、Ambient Intelligence帶來的法律蛻變，以及從去中心化自主代理匿名性到跨物種溝通與跨物種法等主題。
她近期曾擔任個人資料保護委員會所委託研究案「法國 CNIL 人工智慧發展實務指南」的專家顧問。在此之前，她曾於法國巴黎的印度駐法國大使館擔任外交人員考試的英法雙語記錄員（scribe），並擔任該考試準備與複習的指導。她先前曾在師長指導下完成國家科學委員會之勞動契約法專題研究計畫，並發表了關於競業禁止規範的研究成果。
講者.Biography:
Dr. Chen Yi-Ting currently serves as a Postdoctoral Scholar at the Information Law Center of the Institutum Iurisprudentiae, Academia Sinica, primarily tasked with delivering comparative law insights and analysis for AI policy recommendations. Her academic trajectory is rooted in the conflict of laws and the intersection of law and converging technologies, marked by a doctoral dissertation titled International Law and Artificial General Intelligence, which followed a master's thesis focusing on AI regulation and multinational corporate social responsibility.
Expanding upon these themes, she has contributed scholarly work examining legal frontiers, such as the implications of AGI and strong AI for international law as a legal system, the legal status and duty of vigilance regarding artificial intelligence, legal metamorphoses concerning ambient intelligence, and topics ranging from decentralized agentic anonymity to inter-species communication and inter-species law.
She recently served as an expert consultant for a commissioned research project on France's CNIL AI Development Practical Guidelines conducted for the Personal Data Protection Commission. Prior to this, she once served as a bilingual (English-French) scribe for the diplomatic service exam at the Embassy of India in Paris, France, and tutored for its preparation and revision. Under faculty advisement, she previously conducted a National Science Council research project on labor contract law and contributed an essay on non-competition regulation.

講者.Name: Cheng-Yi Huang
講者.服務單位: 中央研究院法律學研究所
講者.Title: Research Professor and Acting Deputy Director
講者.簡介: 黃丞儀，中央研究院法律學研究所研究員兼代理副所長，國立清華大學科技法律研究所合聘教授，於美國芝加哥大學法學院師從Cass R. Sunstein教授，取得法學博士（J.S.D.）。研究領域橫跨比較憲法政治、美國及比較行政法、法律與行為經濟學、成本效益分析、轉型正義、台灣法律史。黃研究員長期關注國家權力如何運作、如何被節制，以及在不同時空與制度脈絡下的變遷。曾主編 Constitutionalizing Transitional Justice（Routledge, 2022）、《2010行政管制與行政爭訟》、《2017行政管制與行政爭訟》等論文集，並與他人合編 Comparative Perspectives on Administrative Procedure（Carolina Academic Press, 2017），並為Oxford Handbook of Comparative Administrative Law作者之一，學術論文散見Law & Social Inquiry、Washington International Law Journal、國立臺灣大學法學論叢等中英文期刊與專書，並於司法官學院、法官學院、國家文官學院、公務人力發展學院擔任講座。近年研究聚焦於國家大型計畫的合理性分析、國家安全與行政權力、美國行政法的結構性轉變，並持續擔任臺灣民間真相與和解促進會理事，投入轉型正義的公共參與。
講者.Biography: Cheng-Yi Huang is a Research Professor and Acting Deputy Director of the Institutum Iurisprudentiae, Academia Sinica, and holds a joint appointment as Professor at the Institute of Law for Science and Technology, National Tsing Hua University. He received his J.S.D. from the University of Chicago Law School, where he studied under Professor Cass R. Sunstein. His research spans comparative constitutional politics, U.S. and comparative administrative law, law and behavioral economics, cost-benefit analysis, transitional justice, and Taiwanese legal history. He has long been interested in how state power is exercised and constrained, and how it changes across time and institutional contexts. He is the editor of Constitutionalizing Transitional Justice (Routledge, 2022) and of two volumes on administrative regulation and litigation (2010 and 2017) published by Academia Sinica, co-editor of Comparative Perspectives on Administrative Procedure (Carolina Academic Press, 2017), and a contributor to The Oxford Handbook of Comparative Administrative Law. His articles have appeared in Chinese- and English-language journals and edited volumes, including Law & Social Inquiry, the Washington International Law Journal, and the National Taiwan University Law Journal. He has also lectured at the Academy for the Judiciary, the Judges Academy, the National Academy of Civil Service, and the Civil Service Development Institute. His recent research focuses on assessing the rationality of large-scale state projects, national security and executive power, and the structural transformation of U.S. administrative law. He continues to serve as a board member of the Taiwan Association for Truth and Reconciliation and remains engaged in public work on transitional justice.

講者.Name: Yu-Cheng Liu
講者.服務單位: 東吳大學社會學系
講者.Title: Professor
講者.簡介: 現職為東吳大學社會學系專任教授。主要研究專長為AI與社會學、科技與社會、俗民方法學、科技哲學、社會系統理論、社會創新與社會設計等。近年來參與國科會晶創人文計劃，探討未來晶片發展與可能的應用，並以科技藝術作品的形式，將晶片應用的未來想像融入對社會議題的反思之中。過去的研究計畫關注穿戴式裝置、聊天機器人應用、自動駕駛、血糖監控與胰島素注射技術、人工智能在健康照護產業之應用的跨國比較研究。相關學術著作刊登於國內外期刊，包括Techné、Current Sociology、Humanities & Social Sciences Communications、政治與社會哲學評論、資訊社會研究、思與言、中華傳播學刊等。
講者.Biography: Yu-Cheng Liu is a Professor in the Department of Sociology at Soochow University, Taiwan. His primary research interests include AI and sociology, science, technology and society, ethnomethodology, philosophy of technology, social systems theory, social innovation, and social design. In recent years, he has participated in the National Science and Technology Council’s “Humanities Innovative Contents-Driven Taiwan IC Industry: IC Design and Future Taiwan” Program, exploring the future development of chips and their potential applications. Through technology-based artworks, he brings imagined futures of chip applications into critical reflection on social issues. His previous research projects have examined wearable devices, chatbot applications, autonomous driving, blood glucose monitoring and insulin delivery technologies, and cross-national comparisons of AI applications in the healthcare industry. His work has appeared in Taiwanese and international journals, including Techné, Current Sociology, Humanities & Social Sciences Communications, SOCIETAS: A Journal for Philosophical Study of Public Affairs, Journal of Cyber Culture and Information Society, Thought and Words, and Taiwan Journal of Communication Research.

講者.服務單位: 國立政治大學法學院
講者.Organization: Department of Law, National Chengchi Univerisity
講者.職稱: 副院長暨法律科際整合研究所所長
